topic: You Say Tomorrow Because Today Feels Emotionally Expensive

meta.originalInput: You don't say tomorrow because you lack discipline. You say it because starting right now feels emotionally expensive. Neuroscience reveals that your brain treats difficult tasks like unexpected financial withdrawals on your dopamine reserves. Procrastination is not laziness; it is an emotional tax avoidance strategy. You delay the work to protect your nervous system from cognitive overwhelm. Lower the activation fee. Tell your brain you will only touch the task for ninety seconds. Once the perceived threat drops, momentum takes over.
